**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/24 (Wed) 16:31
- [FACT] User is involved in a design thinking project.
- [EVENT] User is planning a design thinking project that includes startup activities, interviews, qualitative analysis, concept development, stakeholder sign-off, and a detailed design phase.
- [PREFERENCE] User's hourly rate for the project is 1200 kr.
- [EVENT] User plans to conduct 10 interviews as part of the project.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Project Plan for Design Thinking Project includes five phases: Discovery, Synthesis, Ideation, Prototyping, and Design.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Phase 1: Discovery includes defining project scope and goals, conducting background research, developing an interview guide, interviewing 10 participants, documenting findings, and identifying key insights.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Phase 2: Synthesis includes conducting qualitative analysis of interview data, identifying patterns, themes, and pain points, developing user personas, and creating a journey map.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Phase 3: Ideation includes conducting brainstorming sessions, generating a range of ideas, narrowing down to a select few, and developing a concept statement.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Phase 4: Prototyping includes creating sketches of the selected concept, developing a clickable prototype, testing the prototype with users, collecting feedback, and iterating on the design.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Phase 5: Design includes refining the prototype based on user feedback, finalizing design elements, and getting stakeholder sign-off.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Timeline for the project includes:
  - Phase 1: Start Date 2/28/2023, End Date 3/14/2023, Duration 80 hours
  - Phase 2: Start Date 3/15/2023, End Date 3/28/2023, Duration 80 hours
  - Phase 3: Start Date 3/29/2023, End Date 4/11/2023, Duration 80 hours
  - Phase 4: Start Date 4/12/2023, End Date 5/16/2023, Duration 160 hours
  - Phase 5: Start Date 5/17/2023, End Date 6/6/2023, Duration 80 hours
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Total project cost is approximately 288,000 kr based on the hourly rate of 1200 kr.
